title: One line of .exhibit/history.jsonl
description: One merged PR (spec section 8.3). This version fills the PR fields, files, reviews, ci, classification and szz. The fields that later tickets fill may be absent or null. A file from an older version of Exhibit may miss a field the schema requires: run exhibit history again to write the whole file new.

number.description: The PR number that people see on the forge.

body.description: null when the PR has no description.

author.description: The login. null when the account was deleted.

base_ref.description: The branch the PR was merged into.

base_sha.description: The tip of the base branch when the PR was last updated. It is not always the merge-base of the PR.

head_sha.description: The PR's last head commit: the last commit on the PR's branch. It is not the merge commit. For a squash merge, merge_sha is not on the PR's branch at all.

merge_sha.description: The commit the merge put on the base branch: a merge commit, a squash commit, or the last copy of a rebase merge.

forge.description: The forge the PR came from, such as github.

url.description: The PR's web page on the forge.

change_request_rounds.description: How many reviews in list have the state CHANGES_REQUESTED.

list.description: Each review, oldest first: the GitHub reviews and the PR comments that give a verdict (spec 8.3).

author.description: The login. null when the account was deleted.

source.description: review: from GitHub's reviews list. comment: a PR comment that gives a verdict. A fix verdict has the state CHANGES_REQUESTED and a merge verdict APPROVED.

ci.description: Each check run, then each commit status, on the PR's last head commit.

name.description: The check run's name, or the commit status's context.

conclusion.description: The check run's conclusion, or the commit status's state. null when the check run has not finished or the status is pending.

classification.description: Whether the PR is a fix, by the fix signals (spec 9.1). No other field is allowed, so slice S4 must add the kinds of change here and update spec 8.3.

fix_signal.description: The first fix signal that matched, such as label:bug. null when the PR is not a fix.

szz.description: SZZ (spec 9.2): the PRs that added the lines this fix deleted or changed. null when the PR is not a fix, or when SZZ did not run: history ran outside a clone of the repo, or the fix's merge commit is not in the clone.

blamed_commit.description: The commit that git blame ran on: the parent of the fix's first commit on the main branch, the main branch just before the fix. For a merge commit or a squash merge, that is the first parent of merge_sha.

links.description: One link for each introducing PR, highest confidence first.

confidence.description: The share of the fix's counted lines that point to this PR. Dropped lines are not in the count.

lines.description: The fix's lines that point to this PR.

items.description: One line the fix deleted or changed, as it was before the fix, with the blame output for it.

path.description: The file path before the fix.

text.description: The text of the line, without its newline.

blame.description: What git blame says about the line in blamed_commit.

commit.description: The commit that last changed the line.

original_path.description: The file path in that commit.

original_line.description: The line number in that commit.

author_time.description: When the commit was authored, in UTC.

summary.description: The first line of the commit message.

unlinked_lines.description: Lines whose commit is in no merged PR, such as a commit pushed straight to the main branch.

items.description: One line the fix deleted or changed, as it was before the fix, with the blame output for it.

path.description: The file path before the fix.

text.description: The text of the line, without its newline.

blame.description: What git blame says about the line in blamed_commit.

commit.description: The commit that last changed the line.

original_path.description: The file path in that commit.

original_line.description: The line number in that commit.

author_time.description: When the commit was authored, in UTC.

summary.description: The first line of the commit message.

dropped_lines.description: The lines the fix deleted or changed that SZZ does not count, because they carry no bug: whitespace, comments, moved lines, and lines newer than the bug report.

path.description: The file path before the fix.

text.description: The text of the line, without its newline.

reason.description: Why SZZ does not count the line.

no_link_reason.pattern: ^(whitespace|comments|moved lines|lines newer than the bug report)((, | and )(comments|moved lines|lines newer than the bug report))* only$
no_link_reason.description: Why a fix has no links when SZZ dropped every line it deleted or changed, such as "whitespace only" or "comments and moved lines only". null when some lines are left, or when the fix deleted or changed no lines.
